newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Pertamina says Balongan maintenance on schedule.
newsitem.headline: Pertamina says Balongan maintenance on schedule.

text.p: Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina confirmed on Monday its 125,000-barrel-per-day capacity Balongan refinery would be shut down for maintenance on October 1.

"The preparation for Balongan maintenance has been concluded. The shutdown will be around 24 days for the Crude Distillation Unit and 60 days for the Residue Castalytic Cracking unit," an official at the refinery, some 195 km east of Jakarta, told Reuters.
The official, who asked not to be named, said Pertamina has made preparations to maintain domestic fuel supplies during the shutdown but did not give details.
This is the first major shutdown at the refinery since it started operations in 1994.
The official said the refinery is currently producing over its designed capacity.
